## Description

Uses multi-scale connected component persistence thresholds (Betti-0) to cluster asset correlation metric spaces, allocating risk parity weights across topologically distinct asset clusters.

## Where it may fit

High-dimensional multi-asset portfolio construction, correlation breakdown regimes, risk parity allocation.

## Vehicles

Risk-Parity Funds, Institutional Endowment Portfolios, Multi-Asset Allocators.

## Required data

Rolling cross-asset correlation matrices, multivariate asset return time series.

## Caveats

Hierarchical distance thresholding requires stability across sliding window lengths.
